requirements.quote: Add apps/api/src/routes/inbound-whatsapp.ts (signature verification, sender mapped to a verified link without an oracle, size and type allow-list, dedupe by provider message id)
core receive logic that stores the media in the linked user's workspace capture inbox (#43) and enqueues processing, modelled on inbound-email (#530)
a forwarded PDF or voice note lands in the right workspace's capture inbox within a minute
unknown or unverified senders are dropped silently

deliverables.change: Pure inbound WhatsApp module (plus sibling files and a test under packages/capture/src/whatsapp-inbound/__tests__): WhatsAppInboundProvider interface (verify raw body+headers incl. X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC-SHA256 constant-time, parse messages to {providerMessageId, from, kind, mime, filename, sizeBytes, mediaId}, fetchMedia), type/size allow-list reusing resolveAllowedType/assertWithinCap, env factory; export from packages/capture/src/index.ts
Re-export the whatsapp-inbound module (name must not clash with the existing whatsapp chat-export exports)
Add tenantTable whatsapp_inbound_message (workspace_id, provider_message_id unique per workspace, status, media/mime/size, received_at); export via schema index
Add 'whatsapp' to CAPTURE_CHANNELS (not in DEFAULT_ENABLED_CHANNELS, so opt-in stays)

New migration at the next free number on the milestone branch (re-check ls packages/db/migrations; renumber if taken) plus regenerated meta snapshot and journal: replace capture_channel_chk with the list including 'whatsapp'; CREATE whatsapp_inbound_message with RLS ws_isolation; owner_definer_read policy on whatsapp_link; SECURITY DEFINER app_resolve_whatsapp_sender(p_e164 text) returning (workspace_id, user_id) only when exactly one verified link matches, REVOKE from PUBLIC and GRANT to causedeck_app (as 0059_email_intake.sql:77-88)

Add whatsapp_inbound_message to the root table list; also update packages/db/src/__tests__/rls/sql.test.ts, packages/db/src/testing/cross-tenant-registry.ts and packages/db/src/testing/two-tenants.ts (TABLE_TESTS + seeders), and packages/core/src/lifecycle/deletion/erase.ts PURGE_ORDER (and exporters if its guard test demands)

receiveInboundWhatsApp(db, input, afterInsert): resolve sender via app_resolve_whatsapp_sender (E.164 validated, malformed = dropped), isChannelEnabled(tx, ws, 'whatsapp') gate, allow-list/size check, insert dedupe row onConflictDoNothing, run afterInsert (enqueue) in the same tx; outcomes accepted|duplicate|dropped{reason}

runWhatsAppIntake(deps, payload): fetch media via provider, re-sniff type/size, sha256 dedupe, store.put, blob+capture insert (channel 'whatsapp', createdBy linked user, sourceMeta with provider message id only), then jobs.scan or jobs.process as run.ts:245-260 of email-intake; delete the object on failure
Export receive and run; add the new exports to cross-tenant registry (SERVICE_TESTS with a real case in packages/core/src/__tests__/cross-tenant/services.test.ts or NOT_A_SERVICE with reason)

Job 'whatsapp.intake' modelled on definitions/email-intake.ts (singleton per message, 5 retries with backoff); register in packages/core/src/jobs/registry.ts, add the name to the capture job names if they live in packages/capture/src/jobs.ts

Public POST /inbound/whatsapp (plus GET hub.challenge handshake) modelled on inbound-email.ts: raw body, provider.verify (bad = 400), for each parsed message call receiveInboundWhatsApp, log only drop reasons, always 200 ack; null provider = 400

Add inboundWhatsapp deps and mount the router; wire provider in apps/api/src/server.ts; add 'routes/inbound-whatsapp.ts' to apps/api/src/__tests__/static-guards.test.ts and the route entries to apps/api/src/__tests__/cross-tenant.test.ts (and the OpenAPI snapshot if one is checked in)

Tests modelled on inbound-email.test.ts: bad signature 400, unknown/unverified/ambiguous sender 200 and nothing stored, duplicate message id once, disallowed type/oversize dropped, PDF and voice note accepted and job enqueued, channel disabled dropped

DB-backed tests: accept PDF and ogg voice note into the linked workspace capture (channel whatsapp, status queued/scanning), other workspace sees nothing, unlinked number dropped, duplicate by provider id, runWhatsAppIntake stores blob+capture

Record whatsapp-link -> capture dependency in CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES (packages/core/src/domains.test.ts) and the doc; update packages/validators/src/capture.ts, packages/capture/src/__tests__/lists.test.ts and apps/worker/src/__tests__/registry.test.ts (+ schedules.test.ts only if a schedule is added) for the new channel and job; add i18n/channel labels only if packages/i18n catalog test fails

preserve.what: POST /v1/inbound/email behaviour and signature in apps/api/src/routes/inbound-email.ts and core email-intake receive/run

whatsapp_link semantics from #678 (packages/core/src/whatsapp-link/link.ts): unlink deletes the row, getWhatsAppSendTarget unchanged; the existing whatsapp_export capture channel and packages/core/src/whatsapp chat-export import
DEFAULT_ENABLED_CHANNELS stays ['manual','upload'] (packages/capture/src/types.ts:12): the whatsapp channel is opt-in

pnpm --filter @causedeck/core exec vitest run src/whatsapp-link src/email-intake src/capture src/domains.test.ts --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-1}

decisions.choice: Add a 'whatsapp' capture channel (migration widening capture_channel_chk) instead of reusing 'whatsapp_export'
decisions.justification: whatsapp_export means a chat-export import (packages/core/src/whatsapp); channels are opt-in per workspace (packages/core/src/capture/channels.ts:49-60) and need their own disclosure/gate

decisions.choice: Webhook only verifies, dedupes and enqueues; a whatsapp.intake job downloads and stores the media
decisions.justification: inbound-email.ts:1-10 keeps the handler fast and the WhatsApp Cloud API gives only a media id needing an authenticated fetch

decisions.choice: Workspace-free sender lookup through a SECURITY DEFINER function returning a row only for exactly one verified link; ambiguous numbers are dropped silently
No new workspace package dependency: whatsapp-link imports capture through its index only
decisions.justification: core already depends on @causedeck/capture (email-intake/receive.ts:8); record the domain edge in CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES and docs/engineering/core-domains.md
